_note: Khai TAY năm thứ AST của linux.py không thấy. 'extra' = param worker đọc ĐỘNG (không phải params.get('ten')) — nếu AST đã thấy thì cổng báo thừa. 'api' = param TẦNG API: worker không bao giờ đọc, api/src/routes/jobs.js tiêu thụ hoặc dịch nó trước khi ghi DB — cổng KHÔNG đòi các key này xuất hiện trong AST. 'allowed' = giá trị hợp lệ. 'requires' = param CHỈ có tác dụng khi một param khác mang giá trị nhất định (không thì API bỏ qua âm thầm). 'overridden' = param API ép giá trị VÔ ĐIỀU KIỆN, gửi gì cũng mất — validate phải nói ra thay vì để nó validate xong rồi biến mất. Key của cả bốn khối phải nằm trong AST ∪ extra ∪ api.

faceStrength.why: build_wan_workflow:1641 — WanVideoAnimateEmbeds.face_strength, read through _motion_float(p, "face_strength", "faceStrength") so the AST scanner of run_motion never sees the name. This is the knob that trades driver-face leakage against mouth stiffness (A/B 21/07/2026: 0.6 = mouth frozen, 1.0 = lip timing follows the driver but driver features show through, 0.7 = shipped compromise).

seed.why: build_wan_workflow:1648 — WanVideoSampler.seed, read through _motion_int(p, "seed", default=42) so the AST scanner misses it. character-swap already declares it; motion needs it too, because an A/B whose arms all run on seed 42 cannot tell an effect apart from Wan's run-to-run noise.

faceLock.why: _apply_face_lock:424 — post-render identity swap back to the reference face (insightface/inswapper_128), called by run_motion at linux.py:5288 but defined outside it, so the AST scanner misses it. Needs ~/facelock on the pod (make gpu-facelock); missing install is a warn and the original output is kept.

faceLockBlend.why: _apply_face_lock:424 (passed through to swap_video.py --blend, see its _swap_blended) — merge strength 0..1 for the post-render swap. Added 19/09/2026: inswapper_128 renders visibly fuller lips than the reference photo, confirmed on a real job's own native pre-enhance output, so it's the swap model's own geometry bias — not an enhance artifact, and CodeFormer restore made it worse, not better. Default 1.0 (today's behavior, unchanged, and the fast path since it skips the reimplemented merge). Lower values keep more of Wan's own rendered face; local CPU test (no GPU) showed lip fullness genuinely shrinking from 1.0 down to 0.3 with no visible seam. Tested on video 19/09/2026: the first camera-motion batch run with the 0.3 default came back with the face blended toward the driver, so the 0.3 pipeline default was reverted to 1.0 the same day. That is inherent to the knob — _swap_blended scales the whole merge mask, so blend=b keeps (1-b) of Wan's own driver-following face. Use it to soften a swap, never to correct lip geometry.

faceLockDetailKeep.why: _apply_face_lock:424 (passed through to swap_video.py --detail-keep, see its _swap_blended) — lowpass sigma in frame pixels for the swap's own change, so Wan's high frequencies (skin grain, lashes, the hair strands falling over the forehead) survive instead of being replaced by inswapper's 128x128 render. Default 0 = off, today's behavior. Measured 20/09/2026 on .smoke/ab-face/, where original-02-camera-motion.mp4 and facelock-02.mp4 are the same 452 frames with and without the swap: the swap costs the face region 39% of its Laplacian variance (150.7 -> 92.4 mean over frames 100-300). MEASURED on a 5090 20/09/2026 (scripts/ab-facelock-detail.sh re-swapped that same render three times, 33-35s each): sigma 2.0 restores it to 147.3 and sigma 3.0 to 148.6, ~98% of Wan's own detail, with frame-to-frame change staying at Wan's level (5.19 vs 5.22 mean abs delta; plain swap 5.00) and the identity shift intact — splitting (arm - Wan) against (plain swap - Wan) by band gives low-frequency 1.04, high-frequency 0.71 at sigma 2.0. No doubled edges visible at 5x zoom on eyes or lips. Orthogonal to faceLockBlend: blend scales the change's amplitude (identity dilutes with it, which is why 0.3 was reverted), this band-limits it and leaves the amplitude alone. Does NOT fix inswapper's fuller lips — that is low-frequency geometry and rides through the lowpass. A pod installed before 20/09/2026 needs make gpu-facelock before this flag works.

faceLockMouthKeep.why: _apply_face_lock:424 (passed through to swap_video.py --mouth-keep, see its _mouth_protect) — holds an ellipse over the mouth out of the swap, so Wan's own lip shape and colour survive. inswapper_128 renders fuller, redder lips than the reference photo (its own bias, confirmed on a real job's native pre-enhance output), and because that is low-frequency geometry, faceLockDetailKeep's lowpass carries it through untouched — this is the knob for it, and the two are independent. The ellipse is built from insightface's own 5-point kps: the two mouth corners give centre, angle and scale, so it follows head size and tilt with no landmark or parser model and no index table to get wrong. Semi-axes are 0.64d x 0.30d at 1.0, where d is the distance between the corners, measured by hand on frame 120 of .smoke/ab-face/. Default 0 = off. Keeping Wan's mouth is the right direction twice over: Wan's lips already match the reference better than the swap's do, and the mouth is where the driver's lip sync lives. A pod installed before 20/09/2026 needs make gpu-facelock before this flag works.

faceLockRestore.why: _apply_facelock_restore:497 — CodeFormer pass right after faceLock's swap, to fix the flatter/waxier face inswapper_128 leaves behind (its internal working res is fixed at 128x128). Called by run_motion at linux.py:5375 but defined outside it. Opt-in, default off. TESTED 18/09/2026 on a pod (see motions-studio/feature/face-restore-motion-delivery.md's 18/09 addendum) — fixes the waxy texture and frame-to-frame result is stable (checked, no flicker), but shifts likeness toward CodeFormer's generic prior (fuller lips, bigger eyes, more oval face) rather than the exact reference person. Reviewed by doanhthuc: fidelity 0.5 is an acceptable trade-off. Needs the ComfyUI node+model (facerestore_cf + codeformer-v0.1.0.pth) — missing node is a warn and the plain swap is kept.

faceLockFidelity.why: _apply_facelock_restore:497 — CodeFormer's own codeformer_fidelity knob (0=beautify/hallucinate more, 1=stick to the swapped input). Only has effect when faceLockRestore=1. Default 0.5. TESTED 0.5 vs 0.7 on a pod 18/09/2026: no visible difference in identity drift between the two — raising fidelity did NOT reduce it, contrary to face-restore-motion-delivery.md's untested guess. Not tried: above 0.7.

quality.why: worker KHÔNG đọc params.get("quality") — enforceMotionResolution (jobs.js:105) dịch nó thành width/height/resolution trước khi ghi DB. Đo bằng AST 18/08/2026: 'quality' không nằm trong 39 key của run_motion. pod-smoke.sh:292 và FE đều gửi param này, nên chặn nó là chặn nhầm.

enforceMotionResolution return SỚM nếu preset không nằm trong DRIVER_PRESETS, và worker không hề đọc quality → không có preset drv-* thì quality biến mất, không lỗi, không log. Vô hại ở 540p (đúng mặc định), nhưng ai gõ 720p sẽ nhận 540p mà không có cách nào biết. batch/example.yaml từng dạy chính cái dạng vô hiệu đó.

render_profile.why: normalizeMotionDriverSegment ép out.render_profile = out.renderProfile = "fast" VÔ ĐIỀU KIỆN cho mọi job motion, trước cả mọi early-return. Worker CÓ hiểu 'max'/'max20' (linux.py:2016-2023) nhưng chuỗi đó không bao giờ sống sót qua POST /jobs.
render_profile.escape: Đường duy nhất tới 20 step thật: đặt MOTION_FORCE_QUALITY=1 trong env của worker trên pod rồi chạy lại lô. Nó áp cho MỌI job motion sau đó, nên tắt lại ngay khi A/B xong.

frames.forced: tự tính từ driver: thời lượng của preset × fps THẬT của driver
frames.why: Preset drv-Ns là TRẦN THỜI LƯỢNG, không phải trần frame: worker ffprobe driver rồi gán params["frames"] = _F_drv, ghi đè bất kể bạn viết gì. Đo 18/08/2026 với driver 30fps: preset drv-5s + frames:33 thật ra chạy ~151 frame — gấp 4,6 lần, tức gấp 4,6 lần tiền GPU so với con số bạn tưởng. Validate KHÔNG bắt được nếu không có luật này, vì `frames` là param có thật của worker nên nó qua cổng rồi mới bị vứt.
frames.escape: Bỏ preset drv-* đi thì frames của bạn được tôn trọng — đó chính là hình dạng pod-smoke.sh:293 dùng: { frames: 33, render_fps: 16 }.

render_fps.forced: tự tính từ driver: fps driver, kẹp 12..30, hạ thêm nếu vượt trần frame của box
render_fps.why: Cùng một chỗ với frames. Vượt ngân sách frame thì worker HẠ FPS và giữ nguyên thời lượng (_motion_fit_frame_budget), nên fps cuối cùng phụ thuộc RAM của box — không phải thứ khai được từ manifest.
render_fps.escape: Bỏ preset drv-* đi thì render_fps của bạn được tôn trọng.
